verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS process service ships a built-in assistant is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Ultrametric deliberately has no built-in assistant: it 'runs no model' and uses 'the AI plan you already pay for.' Users delegate work through their own external agents (Claude Code, Codex, MCP hosts) via the CLI or remote MCP, which is not a built-in assistant inside the product.
